(2) cherry_pick_moments[5] — the proposal-before-meeting exchange ('Are you able to email me the sign...') actually occurs at 09:47, not 09:35; correct the ts. (3) script_coverage address_homeowner quote spans a rep turn starting at 00:10 through 00:35; retag ts as 00:10 or clarify the split. None of these are fabrications — all quotes exist in the transcript, just mistimed — so this is a minor, single-pass fix. These are targeted fixes; the overall trajectory read, state changes, and handoff brief are well-grounded and should be preserved.
